scope: Runner cleanup and receipt observability only. No native runtime, graphics backend, builder, resource limit, game input, profile or historical receipt changes.

observed_trigger.run_description: Root diagnostic host-72xhg4ce, compiled add8051, reached native touch initialization and one no-contact sample, NVN window setup, and translation of two shaders.
observed_trigger.runner_failure: After process.wait had returned, unconditional os.killpg(host_pid, SIGTERM) raised PermissionError at the former post-wait cleanup site. The exception prevented saving the run receipt and hid the known native return code from the normal report.
observed_trigger.historical_boundary: Root's later process inventory showed no native host or translator. There was no independent membership snapshot at the historical EPERM instant. This change does not reconstruct, backfill, rewrite or qualify that historical incomplete run.
observed_trigger.later_root_diagnostic: While this source candidate was under review, root's separately instrumented diagnostic reported actual wait return -25 (SIGXFSZ), with the owned group empty. That provisional observation motivates preserving real wait status; this source stage does not claim an ordinary validated game run or first frame.

cleanup_contract.group_ownership: Only the exact Popen PID used as PGID by this runner's start_new_session=True child. Reject noninteger, nonpositive, PID1 and the current runner process group before inspection/signals.
cleanup_contract.independent_inspection: Use bounded /bin/ps -axo pid=,pgid= with a2-second subprocess timeout. Record successful member PID lists separately from inspection errors. Unknown membership remains null, never an empty list.
cleanup_contract.initial_empty: A successful empty initial snapshot skips every signal. A completed host wait is also required for complete cleanup.
cleanup_contract.signal_evidence: Each TERM/KILL attempt records phase, signal name/number, successful-send status and exception type/errno if any. No command output, environment or arbitrary exception path is copied into these error snapshots.
cleanup_contract.error_handling: A signal error, including EPERM or ESRCH, is not evidence that a group is gone. Poll only the same owned PGID; completion requires an independent successful empty membership snapshot and an actual completed host wait. If members remain after a failed signal, stop escalation and report incomplete.
cleanup_contract.escalation: After a successful TERM only, poll for3 seconds; if the group still exists, attempt KILL and poll for1 second. Poll interval0.1 seconds, each ps invocation separately bounded. Inspection failure stops signaling immediately. No name/path/global/PID fallback, Apple XPC targeting, permission workaround or OS setting change.
cleanup_contract.reaping: Nonblocking Popen.poll during observations collects the actual leader status and prevents an un-reaped host zombie from being mistaken for active execution. No exit code is synthesized from the signal requested by cleanup.
cleanup_contract.forced_kill: forced_kill_of_owned_group is true only if SIGKILL was successfully sent. EPERM/ESRCH on KILL is recorded and does not fabricate a -9 return code.
cleanup_contract.limitations: This is a bounded owned-process-group snapshot model, not a general process ancestry or system XPC manager. An un-reaped leader, persisting members or failed inspection remains explicit incomplete cleanup. No broader descendant/name-based termination is attempted.

receipt_contract.finished: bounded_experimental_host_run_finished requires independently empty owned group, actual host wait completion and stable bounded log/proof reads where reached. A native nonzero exit or timeout termination can still be a fully observed finished diagnostic; it is not game success.
receipt_contract.incomplete: bounded_experimental_host_run_incomplete preserves known actual exit_code, command/build/marker bindings, cleanup snapshots/signals/errors, stable log hash and bytes if available, and existing diagnostic fields. CLI exits2 for this state.
receipt_contract.log_read_failure: If an owned log cannot be read stably, save the cleanup evidence with null log digest/size and explicit log_snapshot_error. Do not credit an empty synthetic log or recompute a racing second hash.
receipt_contract.proof_failure: A failed stable C-proof read is separately recorded and keeps the receipt incomplete. The C verifier, expected image/index/resource bindings and current-file fstat authority are unchanged.
receipt_contract.proof_reuse: New incomplete receipts are rejected by the existing finished-state check. Explicit new proof_reuse_eligible and cleanup.complete fields are also enforced when present, so merely relabeling a partial state does not qualify it. Eligibility requires a real reached C verification and read proof in addition to complete cleanup. Historical completed receipts lacking the new cleanup field retain the already approved strict legacy binding policy; historical incomplete receipts are not upgraded.

No owned game, guest SDK, Cocoa window, Metal/GPU work, external service or network activity was launched by this source stage.
